name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Atuin sync server that stores end-to-end encrypted shell history from your machines in PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Registration is open so you can create your account with the atuin client. Anyone who can reach the server can register until you set ATUIN_OPEN_REGISTRATION to false and redeploy; accounts can still be created afterwards with atuin-server admin user create in the server container.
